newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korea Yukong's 15,000bpd reformer restarts Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Yukong's 15,000bpd reformer restarts Jan 6.

text.p: South Korea's largest refiner Yukong Ltd restarted its 15,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) reformer on Monday on expectations of better margins, a company source said on Wednesday.
"Reforming margins will improve and we have decided to restart the No. 2 unit," the source said.

The source said reforming profits were due to return to the black as the company expected to see an improvement in the prices of BTX, an aromatic produced from reformate, the product of the reforming process.
High prices of naphtha, the feedstock for reformers, had forced Yukong to shut one of its three reformers in early December.
The source said Yukong's reformer No. 1 (10,000-bpd) and No. 3 (35,000-bpd) were running at normal capacity.
Yukong runs a 810,000-bpd refinery in Ulsan.
